newsitem.title: MEXICO: Zedillo says Mexico to continue market economy.
newsitem.headline: Zedillo says Mexico to continue market economy.

text.p: Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo vowed again on Monday to continue with a market economy in Mexico and criticized those who tried to blame all of Latin America's ills on economic deregulation.

"It's not the market economy or policies aimed to buttress it, as some insist, that have produced the thorough inequality from which our countries suffer," said Zedillo, in his opening address to the 12th Conference of the Association of Latin American Economic Faculties, Schools and Institutes.
Zedillo said that the market economy expands productive activities and stimulates investment.
He also attacked protectionism, saying this was the major obstacle to development.
